name: sigfv
description: SIGFV · Gestión de flota vehicular sobre Supabase

scripts.check: node --check server.js && node --check db.js && node --check scripts/build-mobile.js && node --check scripts/build-apk-public.js && node --check scripts/healthcheck.js
scripts.mobile:sync: node scripts/build-mobile.js && npx cap sync android
scripts.mobile:apk: node scripts/build-mobile.js && npx cap sync android && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug
scripts.mobile:release: node scripts/build-mobile.js && npx cap sync android && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleRelease
